title: Wayne County Museum

services.name: America 250 Raffle Ticket
services.desc: Purchase Raffle Tickets for a chance to win ONE of these items. The Pottery Crock was made by Jacob Fisher, Lyons circa 1880. The Bicentennial Rocking Chair was created in 1976 to celebrate America's 200th anniversay. You could also win a House's Beverages Box full of mystery Historical goodies! There will be three drawings, one for each item. Each ticket purchased will correlate to a physical ticket that will be recorded on a log and entered into the "fish bowl" containing all tickets. Each ticket will be uniform in size and color. Need NOT be present to win. Tickets will be pulled at the annual meeting in October. © 2026 Wayne County Historical Society, a 501(c)3 non-profit organization.

blurb: The Museum of Wayne County History is located in the old Wayne County Jail that dates back to 1856. The building was the Sheriff's residence, office and jail until 1960.
